hook: Lisa Su has led AMD since October 2014, combining an electrical-engineering research background with semiconductor operations experience to turn the company from a distant also-ran into a primary supplier of AI accelerator hardware. Her MI300 and MI400 series GPUs gave large AI labs and cloud providers a credible second source of high-end accelerators alongside Nvidia. Su holds three degrees in electrical engineering from MIT and built her career through technical and general-management roles at Texas Instruments, IBM, and Freescale Semiconductor before joining AMD in 2012. She was named Time's CEO of the Year in 2024 and continues to set AMD's AI infrastructure roadmap, from CES keynotes to plans for trillion-parameter-scale training clusters.

quick_facts: Chair and CEO of AMD since October 2014, having joined the company in January 2012.
Earned a bachelor's degree ('90), a master's degree (SM '91), and a PhD ('94), all in electrical engineering from MIT.
Held technical and leadership roles at Texas Instruments, IBM's Semiconductor Research and Development Center, and Freescale Semiconductor before AMD.
Delivered AMD's opening keynote at CES 2026 on AI infrastructure, announcing the Helios rack-scale platform and MI400-series GPUs.
Named Time's CEO of the Year in 2024 and awarded the IEEE Robert N. Noyce Medal.
Chair of the Semiconductor Industry Association's board of directors and a member of the U.S. President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology.

achievements.title: Chair and CEO, AMD
achievements.impact: Has run AMD since October 2014, overseeing its shift from a struggling chipmaker into a leading supplier of CPUs, GPUs, and AI accelerators.

achievements.title: MI300 and MI400 AI accelerator series
achievements.impact: Directed AMD's push into large-scale AI accelerator hardware, positioning the MI300 and successor MI400 and MI500 GPU lines as alternatives to Nvidia's AI training and inference chips.

achievements.title: CES 2026 keynote on AI infrastructure
achievements.impact: Announced the Helios rack-scale AI platform, designed to deliver 3 AI exaflops per rack, alongside a roadmap toward yotta-scale AI infrastructure for trillion-parameter model training.

achievements.title: Time CEO of the Year, 2024
achievements.impact: Recognized for AMD's turnaround and its expansion into AI computing hardware.
